military_unit: s standard and the Greek phalanx:

morphology.compounding_rule: Akkadian construct-chains (Bit-[god], Dur-[ruler], Kar-[god]) layered over Greek learned-compounds with linking -o- adapted to a consonant-final or -u root (Neapolu, Megapolu): the capital Hellashur (Hellas-of-Ashur), Dur-Seleku (fort of the ruling house), Alpolu-Tullaru (the polis-city of Tullaru).
morphology.patronymic_form: the Akkadian backbone keeps the 'mar-' (son of) patronymic and theophoric constructs; the Greek dynastic stock carry a -ides/-id- patronymic and a polis-demonym of origin; the throne fuses both - a basileus-house that also carries a Bit- house-name and a mar- lineage.

patterns.dungeons_ruins: buried ziggurats and fallen poleis: 'the Ziggurat of Dur-[name]', 'the Sunken Ekallu', 'the Labyrinth of Heros [name]'
patterns.military_units: the Sharru's standard and the Greek phalanx: 'the Standard of Urlandu', 'the Bronze Phalanx', 'the Lion-Gate Lochos'
patterns.ships: river-barges and sea-galleys: 'Pride of the Naru', 'the Bronze Nesu', 'Boat of Tullaru', 'Nike of Hellashur'
patterns.taverns: 'The [Adjective] [Noun]': 'The Lapis Kylix', 'The Bronze Stele', 'The Olive and Ziggurat'

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - Akkadian reflexes PRIMARY (family_near_eastern / hammuran morphs: Tullaru, Urlandu, Gayandu, Numunu, Rialtu, Itarnu), Hellenic morph variants SECONDARY (family_classical / achillean: Tulrios, Orlandros, Numenos), never real Mesopotamian or Greek gods. All three alignments: the Akkadian law-stele tradition meets the Greek civic cult of the polis.
religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers, warded as lemnu (Akkadian evil) or daimones (Hellenic), keep their morphs + an epithet: Maraxus -> Marakshu the City-Burner (Hellenic Maraxos the Tyrant-Flame); Vacidus -> Bakidu-lemnu the Unmaking; Lusanto -> Lusantu the Hoard-Worm.

holy_symbol_motifs.Gayandu: the alluvial field beneath the ziggurat
holy_symbol_motifs.Tullaru: winged sun-disc over a law-stele, ringed by an olive-branch
holy_symbol_motifs.Urlandu: an iron spear crossed with the city-standard and an oath-ring

religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Bit-ili (Akkadian god-house) or Temenos (Hellenic sacred-precinct) of [power]: 'the Bit-ili of Tullaru', 'the Temenos of Tulrios'.
religion.saints_pattern: the deified law-givers of the cities and the Heros [name] (deified founder), inscribed on the stele and honored at the ziggurat and the heroon.
religion.the_one: Itarnu (Akkadian; Hellenic Aiternos) - the great distant Ancient One, honored not petitioned

worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: Venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon, and names the Lawful powers - and Itarnu - as the tyrant-gods to be defied.
worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful powers - Itarnu, Tullaru the just, Urlandu of the sworn war, Rialtu the merciful - and names the Chaotic powers lemnu (evil ones) or daimones, warded; the law-stele and the polis-oath bind alike
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: the deified law-givers and city-founders (the heroes inscribed on the stele and honored at the heroon) and the city-spirits of the bit-ili; the great powers invoked at the temple and the temenos situationally

titles._tiers_note: Akkadian ladder, ascending, dominant; the Greek civic register stands beside it as the polis-administration. Hazannu (mayor) barony; Massaru (warden) march; Shaknu (appointed governor) county - shown in English as 'Archon', the approved Greek polis-magistrate term, the visible mark of the Hellenistic graft; Turtanu (commander-in-chief) duchy; Rubu (prince) principality; Sharru (king) kingdom over a Sharrutu; Shar-kishshati (king of the totality; Akk) empire over the Kishshatu. The Greek strategos (general-governor) and the polis-archon serve as co-titles beneath the Akkadian crown; the sangu (priest) and scribal shatammu stand outside the ladder. Rank titles fuse the real Akkadian and Greek registers (allowed).
titles.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH (or an approved commonly-known foreign term where set in 'ruler' - here 'Archon' at the county tier). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.
titles.government: feudal (a Hellenistic dynasty over the Akkadian temple-cities: the basileus and his diadochoi-kin at the crown, the Greek strategoi and the Akkadian shaknu-governors over the alu-cities and the poleis, the gymnasion and the agora beside the ziggurat and the bit-ili; the sangu-priesthood and the scribal shatammu serve beneath. Polis/republican forms are aesthetic flavor, not modeled.)
titles.heir: Mar-Sharri (son of the king; the crown prince; the Greek register names him Diadochos)
